text: LV Berkeley authority vs merge-gate reality. COVERAGE.tsv names 117 rows authority=berkeley + 111 project-exact+berkeley-check, ~600 rows naming testfloat-l2 vector sets; README says each row is "gated against Berkeley TestFloat 3e, MPFR, or an exact reference at the volume its authority names." At HEAD: all 411,213 committed vector lines carry project-exact (Fraction) or MPFR expectation tags (255,438 exact / 155,775 mpfr; zero berkeley), tests/berkeley_ingest.py is referenced by no gate script, and the merge gate never executes TestFloat. Berkeley agreement was a historical generation-time/wave cross-check. The authority naming is SF-0's deciding-authority language; the README sentence describes more than the current gate does.

LV Site interval figures stale. site/index.html:148 quotes stream hash ce81d66e and 7.92 s as current; the Wave-6 restamp moved the digest to ae04caf0...c1422 (demo/expected-interval.txt, docs/BOARD.md, README) with compute 6.66 s. Same defect shape previously caught as a plant in the README map; the site page was missed by that restamp. The live Pages site serves this page.

LV Pin P5 is not a seal. src/msf_internal.h:20-26 claims internal RTTZ (value 5) can never be selected by a caller-passable msf_rounding_t. In C a cast (msf_rounding_t)5 passes straight through; no public entry validates rm. msf_pack_generic honours 5 as true RTTZ (src/msf_roundpack.c:60-64,124) while round_mag_to_int (src/msf16/32/64.c), dec_round_inc and to_hex (src/msf_string.c) treat 5 via default as toward-zero. Out-of-enum input gets family-dependent semantics; compat state (raw mutable struct, no setter) admits the same.

LV Committed bench budget cannot complete. board/run_bench.sh captures through board/read_until.py (60 s marker window); the 44-row suite outruns it (docs/BENCH.md itself records the retained logs used a scratch 600 s reader). `tools/run.sh bench` as committed should fail at capture on a full run. The recorded BENCH numbers are unaffected (they came from the labelled parcel run), but the committed re-run path is broken.

LV-shape Ziv final-stage silent fallback. src/msf_math.c trig/explog/log deciders: on final-stage endpoint disagreement they return the lo endpoint's pack (defined fallback, comments say unreachable under the leg-(c) margin argument). The only recording (TRIG_COUNT_FINAL etc.) compiles to (void)0 unless MSF_*_TEST_COUNTERS is defined, which shipped builds never define. If the margin argument ever fails, the result can be 1 ulp off with no flag/trap/counter. Correctness thus rests entirely on worst-case completeness arguments that live in the fenced design entries; no runtime tripwire exists in the shipped build.

src/msf64.c remainder_core lacks the early return its 16/32 siblings take; an unguarded shift branch is reachable only if an unstated decode lemma fails (auditor proved the lemma holds; nothing in the file states or guards it). Fragile-by-omission, not a proven defect.
Header prelude (tools/gen_tables.py HEADER_PRELUDE -> include/...:36-39): tier 2 claimed when "its wave-4 gate has closed"; 27 of 66 tier-2 rows are wave 5 (SF-2 bundle). Generator text not updated.

compat/msf_aeabi.c trap banner rationale ("None of these is implemented by the core") stale: exp2/log2/hypot/remainder (+ ceil/trunc/round/rint forms) have core rows now, yet libm calls still trap. Policy may be deliberate; stated reason no longer holds.
SF-0 2.6 fixes output spellings inf/nan; render_special emits "snan" (shared dec+hex). Study or code is stale; unreconciled.

SF-0 3.4 describes a documented setter for per-core rounding; compat exposes only the raw mutable struct by pointer (also feeds finding 3).

board/common.sh take_lock is exists-check-then-create (TOCTOU; two concurrent takers can both pass).
Stale lock: no PID/liveness/recovery; a SIGKILLed holder bricks later board budgets until hand removal.
Committed board scripts record no git HEAD, against docs/BOARD.md:17-18 (bench labels with HEAD came from out-of-tree wrappers).
